questions.answer: A perception or observation of what people commonly do.
questions.feedback: Do not equate frequency with approval.

questions.answer: A perception of what people approve or expect.
questions.feedback: Distinguish an expectation from a written rule.

questions.answer: A visible pattern may be unrepresentative or conflict with formal obligations.

questions.prompt: Should unsafe common practice be copied?
questions.answer: No; legitimate safety and ethical requirements take priority.

scoring.knowledge: 1 point per correct answer; formative only; use answer-specific feedback.
scoring.practice: Distinguishes observed practice, approval and authorised rules, and selects safe, fair responses to conflicting norms.
scoring.transfer: Analyse a fictional group's norms. Include two descriptive observations, one stated expectation, one authorised rule and one conflict between practice and duty. Propose a respectful clarification or improvement.
scoring.pass: All mapped criteria require Level 2 evidence; no averaging away omissions or safety-critical criteria. No automatic competency award.
